cover_letter: I am registering my interest in Sales and Partnerships roles at OpenAI in London. I have 5 years of commercial and account experience at Global Blue, part of Shift4, a regulated payments business, where I have been promoted three times in four years.

For six months I was interim account manager for three global brands: Dyson, Fred Perry and UGG. I built 50+ commercial pricing models across 40 brands linked to Salesforce opportunities, and wrote the client onboarding playbook that two global account teams adopted as standard. I work daily with partners and colleagues in ~40 countries.

I am also a hands-on AI user. I designed a work-management system for my role with Claude Code, Python and Excel, so I understand what it takes for a business team to trust and adopt AI tools. I have not carried a sales quota yet and would be clear about that; my strength is helping customers and partners get value.
I would welcome a conversation about where I could contribute.

answers.Why OpenAI?: I want to help businesses adopt AI well, and I bring partner and account experience from payments plus hands-on building with AI tools.
